Root cause: The bug was caused by formatting a long integer value (specifically, the authorization timeout) as a floating-point number, which could lead to confusion or misinterpretation of the value. The original code used `String.format("%.2fs%n", ...)`, which formats the timeout in seconds with two decimal places, implying a level of precision that is unnecessary for a timeout value. The fix changes the format to `String.format("%ds%n", ...)`, which correctly formats the timeout as a whole number of seconds, eliminating the floating-point representation and providing a clearer and more accurate display of the timeout value.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by formatting a long integer value (specifically, the authorization timeout) as a floating-point number, which could lead to confusion or misinterpretation of the value. The original code used `String.format("%.2fs%n", ...)`, which formats the timeout in seconds with two decimal places, implying a level of precision that is unnecessary for a timeout value. The fix changes the format to `String.format("%ds%n", ...)`, which correctly formats the timeout as a whole number of seconds, eliminating the floating-point representation and providing a clearer and more accurate display of the timeout value.
